text: maintenance goal move recurring questions toward higher-trust paths: Use logged trajectories find repeated Path B questions, unclear answers, questions agent answer. Stable business metrics usually belong semantic layer. Table choice, grain, terminology, joins, caveats usually belong context layer. promoting recurring question Path , first ask whether existing measure can extended filter, grouping, aggregation argument. keeps semantic layer smaller closer definitions team already maintains.
code: Path A: semantic layer The answer comes from a governed measure.  Path B, documented The answer uses fallback SQL, but the context layer identifies the right table, grain, filters, joins, caveats, or SQL shape.  Path B, exploratory The answer uses fallback SQL with little supporting context, or the agent has to make assumptions.
